article.title: ‘Dumbfounds us all’: Congress struggles with policies rippling from AI development
article.author: Editor
article.content: The challenges and dire threats surrounding the unchecked growth of artificial intelligence appear unlikely to move Congress or President Donald Trump to act as the U.S. Senate enters its last week before the midterms. The post ‘Dumbfounds us all’: Congress struggles with policies rippling from AI development appeared first on MR Online .
